hook: I am applying for the part-time Sales Associate role at Corner Shop. Your posting asks for someone who can work weekends, which suits me well.
strengths_intro: Here is what I would bring to the team:

strengths.label: Reliable
strengths.body: I arrive early and finish what I start.

strengths.label: Friendly
strengths.body: I stay calm and polite with every customer.

strengths.label: Quick to learn
strengths.body: I learn new systems fast and write down the steps.

fit_paragraph: I am available days, evenings and weekends. I am new to your till system and I learn systems quickly.
closing: I would welcome a short call. Thank you for considering my application.
